disclosure: FILED AFTER THE WORK, NOT BEFORE IT, AND SAYING SO RATHER THAN BACKDATING A TIMESTAMP. Every sibling lane in this queue filed CP1 before its first edit; this session read the dispatch, re-verified the premises below at source, and went straight into the fixes, so CP1 and CP2 landed together with the close. What follows is therefore not a pre-registered prediction: each item carries the measurement that produced it, and the falsifiers in `preRegisteredFalsifiers` were run AFTER the fact and are reported as results, not as a bet placed in advance. The failure this disclosure is meant to prevent is a checkpoint that reads like foreknowledge it did not have.

theFinding.headline: Wiring the guard does not make the live regions serve better records; it makes them REFUSE, because no live record satisfies its declared shape today. That is the acceptance wording, not a regression, and it re-scopes the next unit of work from 'add a guard' to 'map the vendors'.

measuredOnTheDeployedRecords.read: 102 live record(s) read from https://app.smartcityos.io with the lane-verification key (cityKey=bastrop_tx), judged by the BRANCH's own `recordShapeFaults`
measuredOnTheDeployedRecords.theStatusFaultIsNotNoise: The live vocabulary is `unknown` (75 Samsara) and Stopped/Idle/Moving/Unknown (27 Spireon), and the mappers deliberately keep a vendor's own value rather than force-mapping it onto this product's bands, which is the module's stated stance. So the enum fault is the honest signal that the mapping has not been done, and it is now visible instead of silent.
measuredOnTheDeployedRecords.theInventoryFieldSet: 12 fields the declared shape does not declare arrive on the live Samsara row, including vin, make, model, odometerMiles: exactly the set the dispatch names.

theFinding.whyRefusalIsTheRightOutcomeHere: The row's acceptance is: 'assertRecordShape is called on the live vendor path and REFUSES rather than defaulting when the live Samsara record fails it' and 'operatorRef is either populated or the record is refused, never silently absent'. Minting a reference was the attractive repair and was refused on the merits: the read holds no operator identity to pseudonymise, and a reference derived from the vehicle would print a pseudonym for a MACHINE in the column that groups people. An absent required field that is stated with its basis, and a record the guard refuses, is the shape the program's own canon asks for.
theFinding.whatItCostsOnTheProvingPack: After this branch is deployed, Bastrop's Fleet and Police live regions answer `refused` with the faults named rather than painting 75 and 27 rows. The UI has a word for it now (`Records refused`) instead of falling through to 'is generating records' over a basis listing refusals. The mapping is the next unit of work; it is named in leave_behind.

preRegisteredFalsifiers: F1 - The live path must REFUSE a failing record rather than default it. Violation: feed a non-conforming row -> `refusedResult` (`status: "refused"`, `recordCount: 0`, faults named); and a conforming row with a namespaced reference must still pass, so the guard is not a blanket refusal. Both run in src/vendor-live.test.mjs.
F2 - Two vendors must not be able to emit one sentinel. Violation: feed an empty row to BOTH mappers and require the labels to differ; plus a fixture sweep asserting the old literal appears nowhere.

F3 - `operatorRef` must be populated or the record refused, never silently absent. Violation: assert the key exists (null plus basis) on every mapped row, and assert the shape still refuses a row where the key is missing entirely.

F4 - The extractor must SEE what the format refuses. Violation: a namespaced reference on a board whose declared format is still bare must be REFUSED and NAMED; a bare reference against the namespaced format must be refused; an undeclared prefix must be refused; and prose that merely DESCRIBES the format must not be treated as a candidate.
F5 - A check that passes on zero matched inputs has proved nothing. Violation: report the matched-input counts, and refuse the verdict at zero on both instruments.

F6 - The named trap must be shown on BOTH sides: the pre-lane instrument must fail on a recaptured namespace (its own bare fixtures go stale), and the fixed instrument with the old extractor restored must refuse a verdict rather than blame the boards.
leave_behind: THE NEXT UNIT OF WORK IS THE MAPPING, NOT ANOTHER GUARD. The live Samsara and Spireon rows fail their declared shapes on the status enum, on operatorRef and (Samsara) on odometerBand. Three separate jobs: map each vendor's engine/NSpire state onto the declared bands with the vendor's own word preserved alongside; derive an odometer band from the raw reading or get one from the route; and find an operator identity on the platform route (the route's `operator` is null on every row read). Until then Bastrop's live regions are refused-whole, which is the true state.

FLEET SHIPS NO VIOLATION SUITE AND THIS LANE DID NOT ADD ONE. The dispatch fixes this lane's doc_repo writes to the two check.mjs files, so the fleet suite lives as a scratch instrument in _inbox (2026-09-18_g153-fleet-police-lens_fleet-violate.mjs). It resolves its source folder by an explicit --src (default P:/doc_repo/_design/smartcity-fleet-lens) because the fixed check.mjs is an UNCOMMITTED working-tree change in the integration checkout, and a copy that derived its path from its own location would silently measure the pre-fix instrument in whichever worktree it was copied into. A durable _design/smartcity-fleet-lens/violate.mjs is a planner call.

THE TWO DESIGNS' DUMPS NOW LAG THE CODE BY CONSTRUCTION. Both declare the bare `/^OPR-\d{2}$/`; the code mints FL-OPR-nn and PV-OPR-nn. 'THE TRAP, FIXED SIDE' case exists to prove the fixed instrument survives the recapture when the planner runs it.
